title: Weak sequential compactness of currents in ℝ^P with locally bounded mass (Simon 6.2.15)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let T_j ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n, j ∈ ℕ) satisfy sup_j M_W(T_j) < ∞ for every bounded open W ⊆ ℝ^P. Then there are a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with T_{φ(i)} ⇀ C (WeaklyConvergesOn: T_{φ(i)}(ω) → C(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Bornology.IsBounded W → ⨆ j, (Ts j).massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), StrictMono φ ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn (fun j => Ts (φ j)) C
